excerpts.author: dimitry8570
excerpts.content:
In bc test all test blocks are on fork defined in network field.

If the network field is transition fork. Then at some point (usually block5) the rules are changed to the next fork. And 5th block follows transition rules

excerpts.author: dimitry8570
excerpts.content: Genesis defined as if you started the client using 'fork' from block 0
